narr: Deep monsoon moisture over northern Arizona brought thunderstorms with heavy rain.
ev: Heavy rain over the Schultz Fire scar (2010) and the Pipeline/Tunnel (2022) Fire scar caused flash flooding over Alice Drive. The water, mud, and many basketball sized rocks made Alice Drive impassable.

Heavy rain over the Pipeline Fire scar (June 2021) caused flash flooding in Schultz Creek. The creek rose 4.84 feet at Highway 180. The water flooded apartments, homes, and streets on the west side of Highway 180.
Granite Creek in Prescott rose about three feet.
Water flooded roads 5 miles east of K'ai'bii'to.
lsr: ALICE DR. IMPASSABLE DUE TO FLOOD WATERS. TIME WAS OF CURRENT OBSERVATION, NOT WHEN IT STARTED TO TOP THE ROAD.
ARIZONA DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION REPORTS WATER OVER THE ROADWAY.
SHULTZ CREEK NEAR HIGHWAY 180 ROSE 4.85 FT. WATER DID NOT TOP HIGHWAY 180 BUT DID GET INTO THE BIKE LANE VIA COCONINO COUNTY OFFICIALS.
